paper_title: Federated Learning-Enabled Hybrid Language Models for   Communication-Efficient Token Transmission
caption: Token Resolution Breakdown for FedHLM: Local, P2P, and LLM Token Distribution.
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates a distribution of tokens across different routing methods within the FedHLM system. The chart is divided into four segments: "LOCAL" which occupies approximately 94.5% of the pie and is depicted in green; "EDGE_P2P" shown in blue, representing roughly 3.9%; "LLM" represented in red and accounting for around 1.6%; and a final segment labeled only as “1%” appearing in a darker shade of blue. The chart includes percentage labels displayed inside each slice, and a legend is positioned below the chart identifying the labels for each segment. The segments appear visually ordered by decreasing size.
